title: AnalysisPlan
description: A research-analysis plan decomposed into tasks with explicit dependencies. Each task may declare the JSON Schema of the output it is expected to produce.

goal.description: The overall research or analysis goal the plan achieves.

id.description: Stable task identifier referenced by other tasks' dependsOn lists.

instructions.description: What the executing agent should do for this task.

dependsOn.description: Ids of tasks that must complete before this task starts.

toolHint.description: The tool most likely needed to execute the task.

outputSchema.description: Inline JSON Schema describing this task's expected structured output.
